name: Streamlabs Alerts
description: A Streamlabs tip lands on your stream as an alert: who sent it and how much, written the way you write money, with a sound, a spoken line and a message in chat. It shows inside every overlay you have in OBS. Installs the alert and connects Streamlabs: one click through its consent screen, then send yourself a test tip and watch it land.
changelog: First release: Streamlabs alerts as a product of their own.
ready_message: The alert is wired and waiting. Send yourself a test tip from Streamlabs and watch it land in your overlay.
notes: A test tip from the Streamlabs dashboard travels the whole way, so it proves more than anything Overlabels could fake. Press it once; pressing it again needs test mode on for Streamlabs.
The alert shows inside every static overlay of yours, on top of whatever is there. Its Targeting tab can narrow that down to particular overlays, but nothing needs it.
Once Streamlabs is connected, its tip counter and latest donor are controls of yours for any overlay you write: [[[c:streamlabs:donations_received]]] and [[[c:streamlabs:latest_donor_name]]].
